title: Beneficiary and Payee Limits under Ashgrove CareAssure Policies
content:
**Owner service standard — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance.** The following limits apply, in every Ashgrove CareAssure tier, to beneficiary designations and to payees of the death benefit: the maximum number of primary beneficiaries, the smallest beneficiary share in whole percent, the age below which a share is paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian, and the smallest payee share that may be settled into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account.

| Tier | Maximum primary beneficiaries | Smallest beneficiary share | Minor beneficiary age (share paid only to a guardian or UTMA custodian below it) | Smallest share that may be settled into an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 10 | 1 percent | 18 | $10000 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 10 | 1 percent | 18 | $10000 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 10 | 1 percent | 18 | $10000 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 10 | 1 percent | 18 | $10000 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 10 | 1 percent | 18 | $10000 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 10 | 1 percent | 18 | $10000 |

Boundary readings in every tier:

- A designation may name 10 primary beneficiaries; it may not name 11.
- A share of 1 percent is the smallest allowed; a share of half a percent is not a whole percent and is below the smallest share.
- A beneficiary aged 17 is below the minor beneficiary age; a beneficiary aged 18 is not.
- A payee share of exactly $10000 meets the Beneficiary Access Account minimum; a share of $9999.99 does not.
